description: Show existing authorized tracking groups across their configured platforms. Reads stored configuration without collection, refresh or setup; no new collection cost. Use the returned group ID and workspace for subsequent reads. Groups overlap, so never add up items_count for a tracked total; use socialseal_get_tracking_inventory.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace override. Omit to resolve the live authorized default or sole accessible workspace.

name: socialseal_list_tracking_groups
title: list tracking groups
